Reporting | VBA Macro Automation | Power BI Dashboards | Team Leadership & Mentoring | Stakeholder & Client
Management | SLA & Risk Management | People Management | Change Management

spans.text: PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Morgan Stanley
Associate — Client & Regulatory Reporting | Team Lead
Bangalore, India
Feb 2022 – May 2026
Led and mentored a team of seven analysts and senior analysts, handling performance reviews, day-to-day
coaching, and keeping everyone aligned on priorities. We maintained 100% SLA compliance across 500+
monthly deliverables in an asset management environment.
Owned end-to-end MiFID II and EMIR regulatory reporting for institutional portfolios, served as primary point
of escalation for complex discrepancies and exceptions, coordinating resolution with internal teams, vendors,
and external counterparties.
Managed client onboarding for 12+ new mandates, working across legal, product, and investment operations
from account creation all the way through stakeholder sign-off. Covered system configuration, SOP
development, template creation, setting up account in internal systems. Cut average setup time by roughly
three weeks per engagement.
Presented monthly KRI/KPI exception reporting and risk analytics decks to senior management, incorporating
detailed statistical analysis dashboards to support data-driven decision-making.
Drove systems upgrade and process automation projects in close coordination with global technology and
investment operations teams, ensuring minimal disruption to daily client operations. Also supported
continuous improvements to policies and operational procedures as part of these initiatives.
Partnered with client managers and relationship teams to produce customised reports, presentations, and due
diligence materials (RFIs, DDQs) for institutional clients across global markets.
Built automated reporting workflows using VBA and Power BI, achieving a 70% reduction in manual effort and
improving operational scalability across the team.
Goldman Sachs
Senior Analyst — Private Wealth Management Reporting
Bangalore, India
May 2021 – Jan 2022
Led business-side client onboarding and systems upgrade initiatives on the Intelledox platform, managing
project transitions with minimal disruption to Private Wealth Management client services.
Designed client-facing interfaces for streamlined access to account statements and regulatory documents for
Private Wealth Management (PWM) accounts, enhancing client experience and compliance adherence.
Developed interactive dashboards to track project status and provided daily progress updates to senior
management across cross-functional teams.
Coordinated regulatory mailings and ad-hoc client communications for PWM accounts, ensuring accuracy and
strict adherence to compliance timelines and SLA requirements.
JPMorgan Chase & Co.
Analyst — Fund Reporting & Operations
Bangalore, India
Mar 2020 – May 2021
Prepared and validated monthly and quarterly fund performance reports, including portfolio analytics,
attribution analysis, and NAV-based reporting, ensuring accuracy, data integrity and compliance with
institutional client reporting standards across multiple asset classes.
Automated 15+ daily and monthly reports using VBA Macros, reducing manual workload by 70% and
improving report delivery speed by approximately 2 business days per cycle.
Served as escalation point for reporting discrepancies, managed daily allocation, validation, and distribution
of client reports, ensuring swift resolution within SLA and accurate delivery across institutional client and SMA.
Conducted training sessions for newly onboarded analysts, ensuring smooth knowledge transfer and process
continuity
Acuity Knowledge Partners
Analyst — Reconciliation & Client Reporting
Bangalore, India
Jul 2017 – Mar 2020
Conducted portfolio and custody reconciliation and anomaly investigation across multiple asset classes
(equities, fixed income), ensuring data accuracy for client reporting and fund-level analysis
Automated the cash reconciliation process using VBA Macros, significantly reducing operational risk from
manual processing and improving team scalability; contributed to continuous improvement of processes and
controls
Developed error logs, trackers, and comprehensive SOPs to streamline operations and support team
scalability
Led end-to-end process transition by mapping workflows from the ground up and creating full documentation
frameworks; coordinated daily and weekly client review meetings across regions, managing feedback loops
with cross-regional stakeholders
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Reporting Tools:
Microsoft Excel (Advanced VBA Macros), Power BI, Bloomberg, Markit, Capital IQ
Automation:
Excel VBA, Python (Pandas, NumPy — data transformation & analysis), SQL
Regulatory:
MiFID II Reporting, Fund Performance Reporting, NAV Reporting, Portfolio Reconciliation
Platforms:
Intelledox, SharePoint, Financial Data Platforms (Bloomberg Terminal)
Certifications:
Six Sigma Green Belt | IBM Certified Data Analyst | Pursuing PMP Certification
Languages:
English (Proficient) | Hindi (Proficient) | Marathi (Proficient) | Kannada (Proficient)
EDUCATION
Woxsen School of Business
Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) | 2015 – 2017
